Committed as `02957ac`. Stopping here as instructed — the WRK-SPEC stays `status: draft` (not transitioned to `active`), and I have not invoked writing-plans.

Summary: `specs/work/WRK-SPEC-BILL-STATEMENT-001-monthly-statement-module.md` designs a `src/statement.js` module (`generateMonthlyStatements` + `formatStatement`) built purely on `billing.js`'s existing `prorata`/`round2`, activating `DOM-BILL-PRORATA-001@1.0.0`. Gate A1 found 14 real breaks — most notably that `round2` isn't exactly half-up at floating-point boundaries (pre-existing, out of scope, now flagged as a knowledge gap), a timezone bug in naive date parsing, and several ambiguity/validation gaps (malformed dates, non-positive fees, invalid months, output-format gaming) — all fixed into the spec; one internal finding was rejected against the project's own WRK-SPEC template convention. To resume: review the spec and, when ready, approve it (`active` + `verified`) and hand off to writing-plans.
